description:
Test an offer

The health test (one short streamed request on your key, about 16 tokens) and, for a draft, the identity checks (a few hundred tokens). Read the outcome with the `get_offer` tool. A draft that fails either check is deleted (contract v2.4): `get_offer` answers 404 and the job (`get_supply_job`) says why under `removed`; to try again, draft the model again with `create_offers`. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

retest.description: Test again even when a test ran before (a listed offer's health). A draft that fails is deleted, so it is drafted again instead.
